decisionsTitle: Who may offer to volunteer: anyone, the club's signed-in members, or only people it invites by email
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-19 08:30**, on the event's volunteers (§754, §768): «On the volunteers form I want extra settings so that I can have "invite only volunteer" "private vs public lists of volunteers" "Brașov Runners only" volunteers.» This decision is the first and the third of the three, as one choice; the public or private list is the next decision's. Amends §754 and §768 (who may offer — the offer's rule) and borrows its shape from §647 (the invitations by email for a registration) and §524 and §552 (the members' sign-in).

**Decision.** The «Voluntari» card of an event gets a radio group **«Cine se poate oferi»**, under «Primește voluntari» and only while it is ticked (`events.volunteers_access`, a closed set of three, default `ANYONE`, migration `0171`):

- **«Oricine, de pe pagina evenimentului»** (`ANYONE`) — what it always was: the event's page carries «Căutăm voluntari: …» and the button, the volunteers' page the form.
- **«Doar membrii clubului (conectați în zona membrilor)»** (`MEMBERS`) — the event's page says «Căutăm voluntari dintre membrii clubului: …» (the same box for every visitor, drawn from the public cache, so the event's page stays static and reads no session). The volunteers' page shows the form only to a signed-in member (`membersViewer`: `MEMBER` or any staff role), with the name and the address filled from the account, the address read-only and «Fac parte din grupul» ticked and locked; a stranger reads «Voluntarii pentru acest eveniment sunt membrii clubului — intră în zona membrilor.» and the sign-in in the members' words (`?to=members`), never the form. **The POST asks again on the server** (`submitVolunteer` → `mayVolunteerWith`): a stranger is refused (`FORBIDDEN`, nothing written, the page then says what it is for), a member's address must be the account's, and `club_member` is set from the account whatever was posted. The session is read for this choice alone and, in the action, only when no invitation came with the post.
- **«Doar cu invitație de la club»** (`INVITED`) — the event's page draws no box; the volunteers' page answers **404** without a valid link, and with `?invite=<secret>` shows the form with the invited address locked.

**The invitations** (`event_volunteer_invitations`, the table beside `event_invitations` of §647 and dropping everything that holds a place): an Administrator or an Organizer (`canManageVolunteers`) writes addresses, one per line, up to 50 at a time, an optional line of the club's (500 characters) and the email's language, and presses **«Trimite invitațiile»** in the card's new fold **«Invitații»** (shown while the choice is `INVITED`, and as long as any invitation exists). One row and one `VOLUNTEER_INVITATION` email per address (the public audience, the announcements' road — an invitation holds nothing, so a late one loses nobody anything): «Te invităm să fii voluntar la <eveniment>», the club's line, the roles that still need people, the event's facts block, and the button «Mă ofer voluntar». An address with a live invitation is not sent a second one (that is «Retrimite»), one that already offered is not invited, and one whose invitation was withdrawn or ran out comes back on the same row (the table keeps one per address and event). The send, like «Retrimite», is refused while the offer itself is closed (`volunteerOfferClosedFor`: not published, the event over, no role needing people, the notice or the agreement not in force) — nothing is sent that leads to a 404. The list shows each address with where it stands (sent, used, withdrawn, expired — three stamps and a date, no status column), and «Retrimite» (a new email; the earlier link stops working) and «Retrage» (the link says «Clubul a retras invitația.») on an open row as confirmed actions. Audited as `volunteer_invitation.sent`, `.resent`, `.withdrawn` and `.used` with the invitation's id and never an address, a name or the club's line.

**The link** follows §12.8 and BR-REQ-036-02: the secret exists in the email alone, only its SHA-256 is kept (`token_hash`, unique), it is minted **when the email is rendered** — the outbox's payload names the invitation and the event by id and nothing else — and a newer email's link replaces the older one's in the same statement; a GET (the page's read) writes nothing; the sign-up **spends it in its own transaction** by one conditional UPDATE (not used, not withdrawn, before its date) so of two presses at once only one wins and a refusal after it takes the spend back; every unknown, malformed or other event's link says the one generic «invalid». The address on the form is the invitation's whatever is posted. A used, withdrawn or run-out link says so in one sentence. A message whose invitation was used, withdrawn or has run out, whose address was corrected or whose event was called off or is over is withdrawn at the send (§331).

**A live invitation is a door in every choice.** Switching the choice later deletes nothing — not a sign-up, not an invitation. `INVITED` → `ANYONE` keeps the sent links working until used; `ANYONE` → `INVITED` closes the public form at the next read (the save tells the public cache); a person the club had already invited is not locked out by narrowing it. The invitation holds nothing and counts nothing: no «needed» seat of a role and no place of a race.

**Carried** by a duplicate, by every date of a repeat and by the event's JSON file (`volunteers.access`, written only when it is not `ANYONE`, so a file of an event that never narrowed it stays readable by the release before this one; applied to an event made new, never over an existing one) — unlike the tick «Primește voluntari», the shirts and the public count (§754, §765, §773), which a copy never inherits: the choice is the club's standing rule for who helps, and every value but the default only narrows the door, so a copy can never open more than its source did. A copy still starts with «Primește voluntari» off.

**Personal data.** An invitation holds an address and the club's line: it is deleted with the event's volunteers (`jobs/retention.ts`, step `volunteers`, thirty days after the event began, counted with the offers), with the volunteer the card deletes (same event, same address), and when the event goes; it appears in the person's data export (`volunteerInvitations`, art. 15 GDPR). **The privacy notice's template** (`{{volunteers}}`'s paragraph in section 5) gets one sentence in both languages — the invitation by email (the address, the organizers' line, when sent, used or withdrawn, the single-use link, deleted with the offer, thirty days after the event) and the member's account filling the form — under the marker that already gates the form (no new switch: a notice approved before keeps the form working and says none of it; the lawyer reads the sentence next sitting). The agreement's text is untouched.

**Where the page is cached.** The volunteers' page was already `force-dynamic` (the bot check's clock, the sealed draft, the answer in the address). Nothing per viewer is stored in a shared cache: the roles, the choice and the texts come from the public cache's one entry (`readVolunteerOffer`, `cachedVolunteerRoles`, expired by every write to them), and the session and the link are met with them after, on this request alone. The event's page stays static because it never reads who is looking.

**Refused.** A second mail per address (that is «Retrimite»); an invitation that holds a seat of a role (an offer is not yet a role given, §761); a per-invitation expiry typed by the club (the event's end); a new privacy marker for the invitation (the brief: the existing gate stays — the owner and the lawyer decide whether a notice approved before may keep sending invitations unread); listing the invitations on the person's page in the backoffice (they are in the JSON export; the page's listing is a follow-up). **Not decided here:** the public or private list of volunteers (the next decision's).
changelogLine: - **Who may offer to volunteer** — the «Voluntari» card of an event has a new choice, **«Cine se poate oferi»**: anyone (as before), only the club's signed-in members (the form fills the name and address from the account), or only people the club invites by email (a new fold **«Invitații»** with «Trimite invitațiile», «Retrimite» and «Retrage», a personal single-use link in each email). The event's page says «Căutăm voluntari dintre membrii clubului» for the members, and nothing at all for the invited. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given an event whose volunteers are «Doar membrii clubului», when a request without a members' session posts the volunteers' form, then it is refused on the server (`FORBIDDEN`) and nothing is written whatever the page drew, and when a member posts it with an address other than the account's, then it is refused too; and given an event whose volunteers are «Doar cu invitație de la club», when a request posts the form without a live invitation's secret, then it is refused, the volunteers' page answers 404 without a link, and the invitations are sent, sent again and withdrawn by the Organizer and the Administrators alone and listed to them alone (2026-10-19, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given an invitation to volunteer, when its email is rendered, then its link's secret is minted then and only its SHA-256 is stored (the outbox's payload names the invitation and the event by id alone), a newer email's link replaces the older one's, a GET of the volunteers' page with the link changes nothing, the sign-up spends the link in its own transaction by one conditional update so that a second press, a withdrawn link, a link past its date and a link of another event are refused with a sentence and write nothing, the address on the form is the invitation's whatever is posted, and a message whose invitation was used, withdrawn or has run out, or whose address or event changed, is withdrawn at the send (2026-10-19, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given an event that takes volunteers, when an Organizer or an Administrator opens its «Voluntari» card, then they choose who may offer — anyone, the club's members or only the invited — as a radio group saved by the card's own form (which deletes no sign-up and no invitation and tells the public cache), and the choice travels with a duplicate, with every date of a repeat and with the event's file, written there only when it is not «Oricine» and never over an existing event (2026-10-19, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: volunteers: the club chooses who may offer — anyone, the club's signed-in members, or only people it invites by email
